# Module 7: Validating Scientific Computations

## Module Arc

- Match each claim to evidence
- Use exact and limiting cases where possible
- Test invariants and properties
- Seek independent methods and refinement trends

::: notes
Frame validation as an evidence portfolio. One test rarely supports every
scientific claim.
:::

## Sources Of Evidence

- Analytical and manufactured solutions
- High-precision or trusted reference calculations
- Invariants, bounds, symmetry, and conservation
- Refinement and convergence studies
- Independent algorithms and implementations

::: notes
Discuss what shared assumptions could make two agreeing implementations wrong
in the same way.
:::

## Build A Validation Matrix

| Claim | Candidate evidence |
|---|---|
| equations are implemented | manufactured case |
| important properties hold | invariants and bounds |
| approximation is controlled | refinement study |
| result is not method-specific | independent algorithm |

::: notes
Have participants create a matrix for the capstone or one of their own
computations.
:::
